profile_text.body:
Wayground, formerly Quizizz, describes itself as a teacher AI and resources company. According to its site, it helps teachers differentiate instruction with AI and track student progress, offering standards-aligned resources intended to engage every student. The company says its platform lets teachers build activities, deliver them to students, and analyze the results in one place, and it describes its AI tools as bite-sized and approachable for every teacher, citing examples such as translating a homework page, adding a real-world scenario, and changing a reading level. It also says it offers academic integrity tools including lockdown modes, anti-cheating alerts, and academic integrity reports.

The company's tracked product is Quizizz, listed in the Education and Research AI category. Its stated uses are quizzes, lessons, and AI generation, with teachers and students as the intended users. Students join by code with a name and no account required. Pricing is listed as a free Starter plan, with the library limited to 20 resources from January 1, 2026, an individual paid plan at about $10 per month, and school plans by contract. The product was renamed Wayground in June 2025. The listing notes it was found in research for The AI Ready School and was not independently verified, and that its privacy practices were not verified.
